boundary: Read-only research pointer. No selector/runtime/proof algorithm change is proposed.

exact_isomorphism.combinatorial_space: Col(2,2,2,2,2,2), equivalently the face poset of the boundary of the 6-dimensional cross-polytope
exact_isomorphism.mapping: Coordinate i is a color class with two vertices +i and -i. OMIT chooses neither; POS chooses +i; NEG chooses -i. A valid signed clause chooses at most one vertex from each color class.
exact_isomorphism.compatible_union: For two JANUS tails, coordinatewise signed union exists exactly when their set union is still a face of the colored complex; opposite signs in one coordinate create a non-face and correspond to a tautological resolvent pair.

primary_source.title: Shadows of colored complexes
primary_source.theorem_statement: For an r-colored family F of k-sets of cardinality m, Frankl-Furedi-Kalai define the colored binomial representation and prove sharp lower bounds on the ordinary and l-shadows of F; these are the colored Kruskal-Katona inequalities.
primary_source.exact_model_assumptions: Uniform k-element faces of an r-colored complex: the ground set is partitioned into r color classes and every face contains at most one vertex from each color class.
primary_source.resource_required: A uniform layer of JANUS signed clauses plus a justified use of a shadow/down-closure relation between output layers.
primary_source.candidate_janus_insertion_point: Replace ordinary Boolean-shadow analogies in the N58 support-mass lane with the exact colored/cross-polytope face poset; test whether any canonical-CNF or resolvent-generation premise forces a shadow condition beyond the already exact Wmax occupancy.
primary_source.applicability: The ambient signed clause universe is exactly an r-colored complex with r=6 and color-class size 2. This is a stronger structural match than ordinary Kruskal-Katona.
primary_source.non_applicability: The set of generated distinct resolvents is not known to be down-closed, a simplicial complex, or a colored antichain with the hypotheses needed to turn the sharp shadow bound into a smaller raw-unit ceiling. The current Wmax already exactly maximizes total width of an arbitrary K-element subset of the signed universe, so FFK gives no automatic gain without an additional structural premise.

related_primary_routes.source: Eran London, A new proof of the colored Kruskal-Katona theorem, Discrete Mathematics 126 (1994) 217-223
related_primary_routes.role: independent proof route; not additional theorem authority over FFK

related_primary_routes.source: Bollobas-Radcliffe / Bollobas-Leader face-isoperimetric inequalities for cube and grid
related_primary_routes.role: Macaulay/isoperimetric neighboring route for face-poset occupancy; exact cross-polytope/star-poset translation still requires theorem-level review

priority_red_test.question: Does JANUS canonicality or the structure of compatible joins imply that the output family, or a controlled subfamily, has a nontrivial colored-shadow/downset/antichain property?
priority_red_test.if_yes: FFK/star-poset Macaulay inequalities may couple support layers more strongly than arbitrary-set Wmax and deserve immediate exact evaluation.
priority_red_test.if_no: FFK is an exact ambient-space identification but does not improve the current raw bound; record NO_GAIN rather than importing a nonexistent closure property.
